required.moduleKey: Registry module key for active module
required.facility: Current facility mnemonic from hub filter

optional.returnRecordKey: Record to reselect when returning to hub

hub_patterns.context_record_contract: contextRecord must already include facility, recordKey, targetEnvironment, userPrincipalName, userDisplayName, sourceScreen, and searchText
hub_patterns.on_select_screen: Set(varNavContext, Patch(contextRecord, patch_nav_context)); Navigate(ThisItem.target.screen, ScreenTransition.Fade, varNavContext)
hub_patterns.on_select_app: Set(varNavContext, Patch(contextRecord, patch_nav_context)); Set(varTargetAppId, LookUp(colModuleAppIds, key = ThisItem.target.app_id_env_var).appId); Launch(Concatenate('https://apps.powerapps.com/play/', varTargetAppId, '?tenantId=', varTenantId, '&source=moduleHub', '&moduleKey=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.moduleKey), '&screen=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetScreen), '&facility=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.facility), '&recordKey=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.recordKey), '&targetEnvironment=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetEnvironment), '&userPrincipalName=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.userPrincipalName), '&userDisplayName=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.userDisplayName), '&sourceScreen=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.sourceScreen), '&searchText=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.searchText), '&launchUtc=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.launchUtc)))

module_patterns.app_on_start: Set(varNavContext, {moduleKey: Param('moduleKey'), targetScreen: Param('screen'), facility: Param('facility'), recordKey: Param('recordKey'), targetEnvironment: Param('targetEnvironment'), userPrincipalName: Param('userPrincipalName'), userDisplayName: Param('userDisplayName'), sourceScreen: Coalesce(Param('sourceScreen'), 'scrModuleHub'), searchText: Param('searchText'), returnRecordKey: Param('returnRecordKey'), returnToast: Param('returnToast'), launchUtc: Param('launchUtc')});
module_patterns.return_to_hub: Navigate(scrModuleHub, ScreenTransition.None, varNavContext) for in-app modules; Launch(Concatenate(hubAppUrl, '?screen=scrModuleHub', '&moduleKey=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.moduleKey), '&facility=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.facility), '&recordKey=', EncodeUrl(Coalesce(varNavContext.returnRecordKey, varNavContext.recordKey)), '&targetEnvironment=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetEnvironment), '&userPrincipalName=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.userPrincipalName), '&userDisplayName=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.userDisplayName), '&sourceScreen=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.sourceScreen), '&searchText=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.searchText), '&returnToast=', EncodeUrl(Coalesce(varNavContext.returnToast, 'Saved')), '&launchUtc=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.launchUtc))) for separate module apps
module_patterns.preserve_state: Persist varNavContext and reapply facility filter, selected record, and search text on hub re-entry

dataverse_rebind_checklist: Replace starter data sources with module-specific Dataverse tables
Map facility/source/target/action fields to real Dataverse columns
Update Patch() payload types to match Dataverse schema
Verify save/refresh/lineage display against the bound Dataverse table
